emergency: Only trains whose unfinished planned closure traversal overlaps closure are held at prescribed nearest station; other trains may queue.
capacity: Exact per-track optional intervals and no-overlap plus redundant cumulative.
P1: Original order and planned running durations; planned dwell lower bounds with safety queueing; minimize terminal delay.
P3: Joint dwell, running duration and precedence optimization; direct FULL warm-starts from P1.
folds: Five stratified scenario folds; four inner folds; final frozen transfer models fit on all admissible base cases.
prediction_candidates: Paper catalog recomputed for actual closure; unavailable and constant columns inventoried; local24/global8 plus controls.
